_note: Manual v1 (2026-10-15) is the current Home Air and Inhalation-Adjacent Products Program Manual for Category 22. The house DOI suffix hmtc.manual.home-air-and-inhalation-adjacent-products is reserved for deposit. cert_doi stays empty until that deposit. Method edition is at /program/method.

versions.label: Manual v1
versions.summary: First Category 22 Program Manual. Fifteen live standards. Numeric ceilings are the values on those standards. Species with no separate number are capped at the parent total and tested on every lot. Metal safety only.
